_meta.note: Storefront UI strings (not rendered). Flat dotted keys (packages/catalog StringTable); identical key set in both files. Variables: {name}. Insert {phone}, {whatsapp}, {ref}, {sku}, {q} and Latin names inside <bdi> (dir="ltr" for phones and refs). Numbers, prices, dates: Intl ar-DZ before insertion. Plurals: suffixes .zero .one .two .few .many .other exist in both files; pick with new Intl.PluralRules(lang).select(n). Example phone numbers inside Arabic sentences are written without spaces on purpose (spaced digit groups reorder in RTL). dev.* keys contain [PLACEHOLDER] on purpose (QA banners); any other [PLACEHOLDER] value awaits the client's confirmation.
